info.name: SFC Paddy Procurement and CMR — Complete Workflow
info.description:
Procurement and shipment workflows are separate: Paddy Procurement and Route Tagging contains e-Uparjan imports, procurement records and the procurement/mapping report. Paddy Shipment and CMR Shipment contain their shipment submit/actions/reports. Route-tag master management remains in Masters.

Paddy Shipment and CMR Shipment each contain required Dropdowns, Submit and Dispatch/Actions. Reports > Shipment Reports contains the shared shipment report filtered by lifting_leg=PADDY or CMR. Master CRUD stays under Masters and logins under Login.

Vehicles are independent shared fleet records. Register with transporter_name, transporter_contact_no, district_id, vehicle_type_id, registration_no and capacity; do not supply miller_id or transporter_id. Transporter master APIs are removed. Vehicle registration accepts ADMIN, OPERATOR, MILLER, PACS, LAMPS and TRANSPORTER accounts. Mutations by non-admin users are scoped to records they created; Core DM remains district-scoped.

Scheme and commodity master CRUD endpoints have been removed. Stock, procurement and shipments now store scheme_code and commodity_code directly. CMR options provide SCMR/CCMR and RICE codes.

Setup: import this collection and SFC_CMR.postman_environment.json, then select SFC CMR ? Local configuration once in the Postman environment dropdown. Postman cannot auto-select the environment from this file. The collection includes a default local base_url; login credentials remain in the environment; local integration keys have a collection fallback. Login response scripts save tokens automatically. Requests are organized by resource: Login, Masters, Users and business operations. Facilities are preserved.

API reference collection with master requests grouped under Masters by resource. Each master groups Add, List, Update (where supported) and Delete. Master detail and restore requests are omitted; use List for records and IDs. Role-specific login requests remain separate. Configure environment variables and the appropriate tokens before sending. Send requests manually; this collection is not a sequential demo run. Every mutation requires a fresh Idempotency-Key; retry_key is only for an identical retry. Core APIs require their corresponding real core tokens and integration.

Trip tracking: Shipments and Trips includes trip detail and numeric trip-status filtering. Configure expected_completion_at in the active environment for an optional planned completion time. Start/completion actuals are set by GPS.

Capacity preserves its submitted value and unit. Original MT examples remain MT: 20 MT stores capacity_value=20 and capacity_unit=MT. API responses include capacity_value/capacity_unit; daily milling uses milling_capacity_value_per_day/milling_capacity_unit. Inputs retain capacity: {value, unit} with KG/QTL/MT supported.

Shipment driver details are manual inputs: driver_name and driver_phone. Paddy and CMR shipment dropdown folders do not contain driver lookup. Driver account management is separate; shipment submission can link or create the driver automatically from the entered mobile number.

Mobile uniqueness: user creation accepts phone via user_phone; Miller registration uses facility.phone. Duplicate user mobile returns 409 MOBILE_ALREADY_EXISTS. Shipment driver mobile inputs reuse an existing driver account; they do not create duplicates.

PACS/LAMPS Paddy shipment source_id comes directly from login data.user.facility_id, saved automatically as pacs_id. No source facility lookup request is required.

Integration header autofill: import SFC_CMR.postman_environment.json and select the local environment once. Send automatically resolves X-API-Key from euparjan_api_key/gps_api_key and generates Idempotency-Key. Local integration credentials have a collection fallback; remote credentials come from the selected environment. Missing credentials are noted in the console; the backend returns a visible JSON authentication error. Postman environment selection itself is manual.

Receiving is separated by workflow: Paddy Receiving - Miller contains pending list, detail, receive submission and received report. CMR Receiving - SFC FCI contains receiver list, detail, accept/reject submission and received stock/stack report. The CMR section uses core_receiver_token; Paddy uses miller_token.

Shipment creator roles: Paddy shipment is created only by PACS/LAMPS; CMR shipment is created only by Miller. Paddy Receiving - Miller remains separate. The Paddy submit folder contains one operational request with an optional explicit-lots example.

Local credential fallback: local e-Uparjan/GPS request headers are filled from bundled local credentials for local_api_origin. No environment selection is required for local integration keys. Remote URLs use only their selected environment keys. This export contains local credentials; keep it private.
